checked.claim: 5 Sept 2025 EUR 3m fine, over 750,000 people, shared admin credentials, no MFA, weak logging; Harju County Court upheld 2 Sept 2026; Allium announced Supreme Court appeal
checked.evidence: AKI 5 September 2025: EUR 3 million, over 750,000 people, no MFA, shared admin credentials, inadequate logging. AKI and ERR 2 September 2026: Harju County Court upheld the fine; ERR quotes Allium: 'otsus kaevatakse edasi riigikohtusse'. AKI: not yet final, 30 days to appeal.

checked.claim: EUR 85,000 Jan 2025; Tartu County Court annulled 26-27 June 2025; Supreme Court declined cassation Aug 2025
checked.evidence: AKI: fine EUR 85,000 January 2025; Tartu County Court ruled on 26 June 2025; security part terminated because it predated the corporate liability amendments; DPO part ended for lack of public interest given minor negligence; Supreme Court declined AKI's appeal in August 2025. The '26-27 June' range is not supported.
checked.replacement: AKI fined the genetic testing company EUR 85,000 in January 2025. Tartu County Court annulled it on 26 June 2025: the security failure predated the 1 November 2023 corporate liability rules, and the DPO conflict (sole board member as DPO) was discontinued on expediency grounds. The Supreme Court declined AKI's cassation appeal in August 2025.

checked.claim: 30 May 2025 reprimand of Bolt, no fine, 30 days to administrative court
checked.evidence: Decision 30.05.2025: reprimand only; legal basis, transparency and retention failures; 'may be challenged within 30 days by submitting an appeal to an administrative court'.

checked.claim: 30 days, extendable by up to 60 days

checked.claim: Complainant becomes a party if formal proceedings opened (AKI complaint page)
checked.evidence: The cited page says a complaint does not automatically open proceedings or guarantee an outcome, but does not say the complainant becomes a party.
checked.replacement: A complaint does not automatically open supervisory proceedings or guarantee a particular outcome (AKI complaint page). Whether the complainant becomes a party to any proceedings was not confirmed.

checked.claim: Three years since 1 Nov 2023 (previously two); two hospital fines cancelled on limitation
checked.evidence: DLA Piper: limitation extended from 2 to 3 years from 1 November 2023. Estonian Human Rights Centre 2026: fines on Ida-Tallinna Keskhaigla and Viljandi Haigla cancelled because of the short limitation period.

checked.claim: AKI through misdemeanour proceedings; EUR 400,000 cap lifted from 1 Nov 2023; corporate liability simplified
checked.evidence: DLA Piper: AKI imposes fines in misdemeanour proceedings up to EUR 20m or 4%; pre-amendment EUR 400,000 cap; 1 November 2023 changes on limitation, higher fines and legal person liability.

checked.claim: Not confirmed whether state and local authorities can be fined
checked.evidence: Estonian Human Rights Centre 2026: 'riigiasutusele andmekaitse trahvi määrata ei saa' (a state institution cannot be given a data protection fine). Hospital fines confirmed (Ida-Tallinna Keskhaigla, Viljandi Haigla).
checked.replacement: State agencies cannot be fined for data protection misdemeanours (Estonian Human Rights Centre, 2026). Public hospitals that are separate legal persons have been fined (Ida-Tallinna Keskhaigla, Viljandi Haigla; later cancelled on limitation grounds). The position of local authorities was not confirmed.

checked.claim: Pere Sihtkapital and Asper Biogene fines fell on pre-Nov 2023 liability rules; 2020 concept never enacted; 2025 competition reform
checked.evidence: Human Rights Centre: Pere Sihtkapital and Asper Biogene fines annulled over legal person liability problems. The 2020 concept and 2025 competition reform parts were not rechecked.
